top_apps.description_excerpt:
Welcome to a fresh and challenging vegetable-themed puzzle game set on your dining table!

This game uses classic match-3 mechanics: match three identical vegetable blocks to clear them from the board. But there’s a twist — the blocks are stacked in multiple overlapping layers, and only the topmost visible blocks can be matched and removed. Carefully plan and clear upper layers to reveal and access the blocks underneath.

You must also manage a limited number of placeholders at the bottom of the screen where matched blocks are placed before clearance. If these placeholders fill up before you can clear the blocks, the game ends. This combination of layered blocks and finite placeholders creates a thrilling challenge that exercises both your strategic thinking and quick decision-making skills.

Dive into this addictive puzzle, match crunchy carrots, leafy greens, and more to clear levels and unlock surprises.

Niti Rummy is a casual 13-card Indian Rummy practice game.

Game Rules:

• Each of the four players draws 13 cards from a standard 52-card deck.

• Designate one card as the wild card for the round.

• When it's your turn, draw a card from the face-up deck or the deck, then discard one card.

• Form at least two straights, at least one of which must be a straight (without the wild card).

• Complete the remaining hand with a straight or a flush (three of a kind or four of a kind).

• When you have all 13 cards, you declare yourself the winner of the round.

Scoring is based on practice points, calculated according to the remaining unpaired hands of your opponents. The first player to achieve the matching goal wins the round.

top_apps.name: Sonoklo - Block puzzle game
top_apps.description_short: Keep the board clean! Minimalist and relaxing puzzle game
top_apps.description_excerpt:
🧠 How to play Sonoklo

You will have the opportunity each turn on a 6x6 board to change the gravity in one of the four directions (up, right, left, down). Applying a new gravity will slide all pieces present on the board toward that direction. Pieces are shapes made up of between 1 and 4 blocks that appear randomly on the board after each gravity change. If you are able to complete a full line of blocks on the board, it self-clears it and gives you points adding up to your score. But if the next shape that has to spawn on the board doesn't have any space left, you lose the game.

🎭 Wear your favourite colours with the shop

While playing, or through Play Store purchases, you can acquire coins. Coins can be used to buy new skins in the shop that you can equip at any time to change the mood and the appearance of your game. Some skins are more special than others and will require more coins to unlock them. There are also 3 exclusive skins can be unlocked by being an early or a paying supporter (Thank you all for your support).

Sonoklo is not only a puzzle game, but also a collection game.
